facts.fact: The article states that Angola's health information system is overseen by GEPE, the Office of Studies, Planning and Statistics within the Ministry of Health, which has been moving it onto DHIS2 since 2015 with support from WHO, USAID and UNICEF; no date is given for the statement, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Health Information System of Angola (SIS Angola) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The article states that GEPE, with WHO support, is revising the Strategic Plan of the National Health Information System (PESIS) and that the ministry has begun data collection for a new strategic plan for 2024-2030, which is in preparation and not reported as adopted; no date is given, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Health Information System of Angola (SIS Angola) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The article states that the European Union finances the preparation of the 2024-2030 health information system strategic plan and funded equipment for GEPE, six laptops (five EU-financed) within a wider delivery of 64 laptops and 354 smartphones to the ministry; no date is given, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Health Information System of Angola (SIS Angola) on DHIS2

facts.fact: Citing UNICEF Angola's analysis of the 2024 general state budget, the article states that an allocation for health information and communication technologies is present in the budget but remains limited; the allocation is not tied to DHIS2 by name and no amount is given.
facts.system: Health Information System of Angola (SIS Angola) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The article states that on the DHIS2 platform data are collected and reported on paper at health facilities, then aggregated and entered into the system at municipal or provincial level; no date is given, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Health Information System of Angola (SIS Angola) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The article states that health facilities collect and report their data in paper format, with entry into DHIS2 made at municipal or provincial level; it gives no count or share of facilities entering their own reports, and no date, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Health Information System of Angola (SIS Angola) on DHIS2

systems.country_label: Sistema de Informação em Saúde (SIS Angola)
systems.tiers: paper at health facilities; entered at municipal or provincial level; central database tracking 125 indicators

systems.country_label: Health Maps (GEPE Research and Projects Department)
systems.tiers: dataset of health facilities by municipality: location, staff, infrastructure, services, beds, vehicles

systems.owner: National Program for the Control of Neglected Communicable Diseases (PNCDTN)
systems.tiers: collected in schools and communities, aggregated at district level, largely on paper; being integrated into DHIS2 since 2019

note: plan:current is recorded for a plan the article describes as under revision and in preparation, not adopted; finance:domestic rests on a general health ICT budget allocation, not a line naming the system. The article also reports 52 health units in Huambo trained to produce monthly reports in Excel under the SASH programme (2011-2017), not recorded as a fact.
